interpretation: Same-M3 calibration-trial scoring was lower, not higher, than strict independent post-M3 scoring for both arms. The C1 advantage remained positive on both surfaces. The diagnostics therefore do not require a V2 to correct reuse optimism.
successor_boundary: Any M3-aware training must be a separately preregistered V2 and may not alter H1 CAL-AUG V1 checkpoints, protocol, Docker images, or official results.
